subject.title: [Feature]: Diffs viewer: per-file +/- stats and multi-file summary navigation

question: Should the bundled Diffs plugin ship the linked PR's SSR changed-files summary navigation and static-export toolbar suppression as the intended viewer/export UX?
rationale: The code path is bounded, but this is new user-visible viewer/export behavior on a protected maintainer-labeled feature issue with an open implementation candidate.

options.title: Approve Linked Diffs UX PR
options.body: Review and land the linked implementation if maintainers accept the host-document summary/nav and image-mode toolbar suppression as the desired product shape.

options.title: Request Visual Export Proof First
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until a real viewer plus PNG/PDF artifact capture proves the layout and static-export behavior.

options.title: Narrow Or Defer
options.body: Ask the PR author to split or defer toolbar suppression if maintainers only want the summary/navigation part now.

recommendation.title: Approve Linked Diffs UX PR
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked implementation if maintainers accept the host-document summary/nav and image-mode toolbar suppression as the desired product shape.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the issue sponsor and the most recent Diffs renderer/viewer contributor in the inspected history.
